navigationChrome.memberRail: Category boards, personal folders and saved feeds, with public presence in the footer. Folder and category board rows share active, unread and visibility state; direct messages and Inbox filters stay on their own surfaces.
navigationChrome.memberDrawer: At 860px and below, the enhanced drawer owns keyboard focus while the main page is covered and restores visible focus on dismissal or resize. Native fragment links and no-JavaScript navigation remain available.
navigationChrome.operatorAreas: Horizontal area links above 860px; a native disclosure headed by the current area at 860px and below. Both presentations use the same ordered, role- and flag-gated destinations.

prose.purpose: System sans-serif, 1.125rem, unitless 1.65 leading and 65ch measure.

meta.purpose: At least .875rem at the default scale, with ordinary-text contrast.

mono.purpose: System monospace; local scrolling for long code.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Overlay elevation; focus uses a separate outline.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Short interaction feedback; reduced-motion preferences suppress transitions.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit action with a readable filled state and 44px target.
components.css: .btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); min-height: 44px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }

components.name: Discussion prose
components.description: A readable measure, clear paragraph spacing and underlined links.
components.css: .prose { font-size: var(--text-prose); line-height: 1.65; max-inline-size: var(--measure-prose); } .prose a { text-decoration: underline; }

narrative.northStar: Make reading and participating familiar, clear and accessible.
narrative.overview: The Forum theme replaces Imladris. Neutral surfaces, system typography, blue actions and ordinary forum language support the existing PHP-rendered Community Inbox.
keyCharacteristics: System fonts and relative text sizes
Responsive rows and bounded reading measure
rules: WCAG 2.2 AA target; verification status must be explicit.
Preserve native HTML and progressive enhancement.
Operator branding and stored preference keys retain their contracts.
dos: Test actual rendered states in both themes.
Honor browser sizing, reduced motion and forced colors.
Use semantic tokens and familiar action labels.
donts: Do not restore legacy font preloads or fantasy-only UI labels.
Do not claim conformance from automated scans alone.
Do not rewrite authored content as part of theme migration.
